evals.name: fix-all-findings
evals.prompt: Address the open findings in the code review for the discount module (the review is under reviews/discount-module/).
evals.expected_output: All 4 findings driven to a terminal status; blockers FIX-1/FIX-2 fixed in code WITH new regression tests; DOC-1 comment + CLEAN-1 duplicate constant addressed; resolution-v1.md updated per finding (status+commit+note) with top-level status=resolved; review-v1.md untouched; nothing marked 'verified'; one commit per finding referencing its ID.
expectations: review-v1.md is byte-identical to the base commit (immutable, not edited)
resolution-v1.md contains no finding with status 'verified'
FIX-1 and FIX-2 are marked status: fixed in resolution-v1.md with a commit SHA
getUserCart is scoped: getUserCart('bob') returns Bob's items, not Alice's
At least 2 new regression tests were added and the full test suite passes (node --test, >2 tests)
DOC-1 and CLEAN-1 are at a terminal status (fixed) in resolution-v1.md
resolution-v1.md top-level status is 'resolved' with fixed_commit set
At least one git commit message references a finding ID (FIX-1/FIX-2/DOC-1/CLEAN-1)

evals.name: blockers-only
evals.prompt: Fix just the two blocker findings (FIX-1 and FIX-2) from the discount-module review. Leave the rest for later.
evals.expected_output: Only FIX-1 and FIX-2 fixed (code + regression tests), recorded in resolution-v1.md; DOC-1 and CLEAN-1 left at status: open; review-v1.md untouched; nothing marked 'verified'; commits reference the finding IDs.
expectations: review-v1.md is byte-identical to the base commit (immutable, not edited)
resolution-v1.md contains no finding with status 'verified'
FIX-1 and FIX-2 are marked status: fixed with a commit SHA
applyDiscount clamps and getUserCart is scoped (both blocker bugs fixed in code)
Regression tests added for the blockers and the suite passes (node --test)
DOC-1 and CLEAN-1 remain status: open (scope respected, not over-reaching)
At least one commit message references FIX-1 or FIX-2
